scope.selectionPolicy: Sort upstream ICML and NeurIPS IDs separately by numeric year and suffix. Exclude all corpus C/D/E IDs, any sources previously inspected or prepared in the three named experiment roots, and PDFs matching any A–E hash. Take first six eligible per conference, requiring accessible original official-proceedings PDF, corroborated caption/page identity, and at least two published objects across first two distinct annotated physical pages (or the only annotated page). Include every published annotation on those pages. Selection is deterministic, nonrandom, and made without model or heuristic predictions. Unselected pages and objects missed by upstream annotations are outside scope.
scope.inspectionScope: Every selected original page was rendered and individually read, with every predicted selected-page candidate inspected in source-derived diagnostic crop sheets. All 29 published checks were paired old/new; the one surplus candidate was independently classified from original visibility.
scope.notInspected: Unselected physical pages and their candidates; full-document gold completeness; live reader/UI workflows; runtime UAT; implementation code.
scope.noTuning: No code, labels, source capture or prediction files were edited; no alternative profile, build, test, lint, formatter, model, OCR, cloud call, or dependency installation was run.

summary.lostOldPassCalculation: 26 baseline passes = 26 retained + 0 lost; 27 candidate passes = 26 retained + 1 newly passed. The aggregate gain alone was not used to infer no losses.

method.coordinates: Rectangles are PDF points [left,bottom,right,top], pageIndex zero-based. Source image pixel origin is top left; at 144 DPI x=2*xPt, y=imageHeight-2*yPt; integer floor/ceil crops. All selected pages have zero rotation.
method.cropMeaning: Diagnostic source-image unions of predicted body+caption boxes, with red outline=body and blue outline=caption. The union may show internal labels outside the red body even when body-only extraction omits them. These are audit renderings, not UI exports.
method.viewProtocol: All 22 full-page source PNGs were actually read individually. All 33 distinct old/new predicted-geometry crop PNGs were actually seen through the 18 listed sheets; unchanged geometry is shared across versions. Two additional source context crops show visible missing bodies.
method.captionCaveat: Caption rectangles are glyph-tight metric bounds; correct caption membership is not a guarantee of padded, pixel-perfect typography in an exported crop.
method.scoreProtocol: Frozen paired static pass requires matched body AND caption IoU >= 0.5. Null evaluator IoUs for caption-only objects remain null, not zero and not a successful body detection.
method.sourceAuthority: Original rendered PDF controls visual membership; published annotation controls frozen score only; automatic label matching is triage rather than precision proof.

interpretationLimits: Deterministic nonrandom Conference150 v2 annotation slice; not representative sampling or a new leaderboard.
All selected published annotations were included, but upstream annotations can be incomplete/imperfect; absence of automatic unmatched identities is not exhaustive precision evidence.
The surplus Figure 1 is one false caption candidate in both versions, so 30 outputs must not be presented as 30 true objects or perfect precision.
Passing IoU does not imply clean/full body membership: retained missing internal labels and baseline missing four panels are explicitly preserved.
No extrapolation to unselected pages/full documents, UI action success, speed ranking or other models/tools.
Paper PDFs, paper text and rendered images remain local; publication should use concise identifiers, scores, rectangles and visual findings only.

limits: C/D/E 用于调试和校准，不能当独立泛化证据；F 是确定性非随机公开切片。
108 与 29 个核验点不等于全文精确率／召回率；全部未选页、中文、扫描页和人工金标准复审未测。
F 仍有一个正文误题注；三个主体未关联和三个过阈值裁图内部文字缺失均保留。
